GdiDrawing.description: System.Drawing APIs for 2D graphics, imaging, and printing that are available via NuGet package System.Drawing.Common. Note: Not recommended for server scenarios due to Windows dependencies; consider cross-platform alternatives like SkiaSharp or ImageSharp for new code.

CodeAccessSecurity.description: Code Access Security (CAS) APIs that were removed in .NET Core/.NET for security and performance reasons. CAS provided fine-grained security policies but proved complex and ineffective. Remove CAS usage; not supported in modern .NET.
CodeAccessSecurity.label: Code Access Security (CAS)
